app_info.name: PWS ILP MELATI
app_info.description: Digitalisasi Ceklis Kunjungan Rumah Kader & Dashboard PWS Integrasi Layanan Primer UPT Puskesmas Melati

target_roles.tone: Warm, accessible, ultra-intuitive, large touch targets, Bahasa Indonesia
target_roles.nav_style: Fixed Bottom Navigation (5 items: Beranda, Keluarga, Kunjungan, Tugas, Profil)
Sidebar navigation with quick filters & export controls

style_mix: Tactile Mobile Cards for Kader (Warm Organic Health)
Swiss Technical High-Density Data Grid for Admin Dashboard
Interactive Step-by-Step Guided Wizard for Home Visits

guidelines: MUST NOT use Inter for main headings; use Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit for warmth and Indonesian context suitability
Always set tracking-tight on headings text size >= 24px
All label text on mobile buttons for Kader must be min 16px (text-base) and font-semibold for maximum legibility outdoors

rules: Status system strictly follows 4 colors with TEXT + ICON always present alongside color fill
Red = Prioritas / Tanda Bahaya (AlertOctagon / ShieldAlert icon)
Never use pure black #000000. Use slate-900 or slate-800 for text
Interactive buttons on Kader UI must have explicit hover text color state

kader_mobile_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 pb-24 shadow-lg border-x border-slate-200 relative
kader_mobile_layout.header: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
kader_mobile_layout.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto z-50 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 shadow-2xl px-2 py-2 grid grid-cols-5 text-center

admin_desktop_layout.sidebar: w-64 bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 flex flex-col shrink-0 min-h-screen sticky top-0
admin_desktop_layout.content_area: flex-1 p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto max-w-7xl mx-auto

ui_components: Dynamic Target Group Selector cards with icon & age guidance
Large Touch Toggle Cards for Yes/No (Ya / Tidak) with 56px minimum touch target height
Info Tooltip modal/sheet trigger ('Apa maksudnya?') providing operational definitions for cadres
Auto-save draft indicator ('Draf Tersimpan Otomatis') with timestamp
Red Warning Alert Box whenever a 'Tanda Bahaya' (danger sign) is flagged

sections: KPI Header Cards: Coverage percentage, Total Families visited, Red Priority cases, Pending Follow-ups
Interactive Priority List filterable by status (Red / Yellow / Green / Region / Target Group)
Follow-Up Action Center (Pusat Tindak Lanjut) with assignment to Health Officer / Bidan Desa
Weekly & Monthly Automated Recap generator with PDF, Excel, and CSV download buttons
Master Data Management: Kader accounts, Dusun/RT/RW regions, and Dynamic Questionnaire Manager
Simulated Accreditation Dashboard (Dashboard Akreditasi): Editable indicator cards, trends chart, narrative summary, PDCA/PDSA cycle tabs, and full-screen Presentation Mode

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dual-viewport approach: Kader UI is mobile-first (max-w-md centered on desktop or responsive full width on mobile) while Admin UI is full-screen desktop dashboard
Implement mock state persistence with localStorage so Kader can save visit drafts and resume them seamlessly
Ensure all forms in Kader wizard use single question / card grouped layouts instead of standard bureaucratic tables
Every warning indicator must present clear actionable advice for cadres (e.g. 'Rujuk ke Puskesmas Segera' or 'Jadwalkan Kunjungan Ulang dalam 3 Hari')
Ensure all components include data-testid for key user flows as listed in testing_conventions
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) on headers & sticky bars
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always specify explicit properties
MUST NOT center align the app container Globally. Keep natural text flow
Always use modern button styles (pill or rounded-xl) with hover states & high contrast
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons. Use lucide-react icons
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format
